title: Step 5: Decide win, lose, and draw

blocks.content: Step 5: Decide win, lose, and draw

items: added the getResult() method to store the result of the game

blocks.content: Here, the getResult() method compares the computerPick and userPick and returns

items: "draw" if the computer pick and the user pick are the same
"win" if the user wins using the rule we described earlier
"lose" if neither condition for draw and win is met
